content.title: Blog 3 — No Kings
content.text: 3/30/26 Caroline Kavit 3/30/26 After An Estimated 8 Million Turn Out For Historic Third No Kings Day of Nonviolent Action, Organizers Turn To Next Actions By bringing tens of thousands of new protesters into the fold, the No Kings coalition is flooding local organizations with the exact people power needed to escalate our tactics and sustain this fight for the long haul. As working families across the country are being crushed by rising cost of living, workers, students, and families will show up together on May 1 for a day of action to demand politicians put our rights and futures first. Additional actions will be announced throughout the spring.
